items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: Larry Crosby was supposed to send me the music and I never did get it

ctx.x: No. I've heard the record, you know, that Wingy.

What's the name of the movie? Uh, uh, Rhythm on the River. It's a good tune. It's a good tune, sure. Uh, Larry Crosby was supposed to send me the music and I never did get it, so... I might have it. Yeah? Call me when I get back to work. Yeah. And I'll look it up right there for you. Yeah, all right.
I've got it by Wingy. And I... You did, yeah. You know the record? I think it's on the back of I think, well, ain't it a shame about name or something like that, you know?
